name: write_file
description: Write string content as a file to a Hugging Face bucket, model, dataset, or Space.

content.description: String content to write to the Hub.

repo_id.description: Hub repo id, or bucket id when repo_type is bucket.

path_in_repo.description: File path to create in the repo, or object path in the bucket.

repo_type.description: Repository type: model, dataset, space, or bucket.

create_if_missing.description:
Create the repo or bucket if it does not already exist.
This matches the default behavior of `hf upload` for repos.

private.description: Optional privacy setting when creating the repo or bucket.

space_sdk.description: Space SDK to use when creating a Space.

revision.description: Branch or revision for repo uploads.

create_pr.description: Open repo uploads as a pull request instead of committing directly.

commit_message.description: Optional commit message for repo uploads.

commit_description.description: Optional commit description for repo uploads.

encoding.description: Text encoding used to convert the string to bytes.
